verdict.rationale: Puzzle's marketing says busywork tasks are 'described once, done automatically,' and it documents custom categorization rules and AI Close agents that reconcile and review transactions, so user-defined automation exists. The evidence does not show how these run in the background: there is no documented scheduler, trigger model, or recurring unattended runs, and outputs are reviewed by the user before they are final. Missing for 10: documented recurring schedules or event triggers, evidence of fully unattended background execution, in-depth setup docs beyond titles, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
